firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently scored a goal becomes the first player and receives the Stage marker.
clarifications: Monday and Matchday are simultaneous; on Tuesday through Thursday, the first player acts first and play proceeds clockwise.
At the end of the week, the Stage marker passes to the player on the first player's left, who starts the next week.
